void instantiate_captured_graph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t& graph, cudaGraphExec_t& exec) {
    check_cuda(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph), "cudaStreamEndCapture");
    check_cuda(cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0), "cudaGraphInstantiate");
}

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");
        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

GLOBAL_THRESHOLD_UPDATE_PERIOD_SHARDS задаёт частоту периодического пересчёта current_threshold.
Финальный global threshold считается только после финального flush и локальной финальной дедупликации.

После финального threshold выполняется балансировка нагрузки по картам.

solved_flag / stop_flag / solved_count / solved_meta_list живут вне scratch_pool.
GOAL_SCORE_KEY = 0.
Goal-кандидат пишет score_key = GOAL_SCORE_KEY.

CUDA Graph используется на повторяемых job-шаблонах.
Dispatcher остаётся вне CUDA Graph.

generators остаётся в constant memory.
zobrist хранится как Hash128[STATE_STORAGE_LEN][STATE_VALUE_PAD].
State хранится как State128.
CandidateMeta имеет размер 32 байта.
route_packed хранит source_rank + owner + move.
GLOBAL_BEAM_WIDTH_EFFECTIVE используется во всех вычислениях порога, балансировки и логах.
```
---
Approved clarification: Stream4 custom GPU fixed-capacity dedup
```text
approval_id = approve_custom_stream4_gpu_dedup_fixed_capacity_2026_05_20

Stream 4 may implement the shard-local:
    threshold + compact + sort + dedup

as:
    threshold + custom GPU fixed-capacity hash-table insert/dedup + table dump

Specialization:
    key   = Hash128
    value = CandidateMeta
    input = survivor_shard[shard][0 : clean_count[shard] + dirty_count[shard]]
    capacity = 2 * STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES

Hard requirements:
    no CPU count/read/scheduling in Stream 4 hot path
    no Python data-plane
    no dynamic hot-path allocation
    no CUB sort count dependency
    no top-k shard cap
    no semantic shard cap beyond fixed buffer capacity
    keep best CandidateMeta by score_key
    tie-break deterministic by parent_idx then route_packed

Output contract remains:
    survivor_shard[shard][0 : new_clean_count] = clean deduped survivors
    clean_count[shard] = new_clean_count
    dirty_count[shard] = 0
    processing_flag[shard] = false

This clarification changes implementation mechanics only.
Stream semantics remain threshold + dedup by Hash128 + best CandidateMeta.
```

void check_cuda(cudaError_t status, const char* op) {
    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(op) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
    }
}

void instantiate_captured_graph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t& graph, cudaGraphExec_t& exec) {
    check_cuda(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph), "cudaStreamEndCapture");
    check_cuda(cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0), "cudaGraphInstantiate");
}

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");
        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

[186] assistant: Предлагаю заменить текущий `run_depth_cuda_graphs` на state-machine scheduler.

**Схема**
- `ring_slot`: `FREE -> S1S2_RUNNING -> DONE_FOR_STREAM3 -> FREE`.
- `ring`: Stream3 запускается сразу после готовности всех slots кольца.
- `stream4_slot`: `FREE -> RUNNING -> FREE`, без drain после каждого запуска.
- `threshold_update`: отдельная job, ждёт только безопасное состояние shard-ов, Stream1 при этом продолжает работать.
- финальный barrier остаётся только перед `layout_final`, потому что архитектура требует полного drain.

**Что убрать**
- `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream1)` после каждой wave.
- `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream3)` перед Stream4 scheduling.
- Stream4 slot drain внутри каждой wave.
- wave-подход `launch all ring slots -> wait -> stream3 -> wait -> stream4 -> wait`.

**Что добавить**
- events: `ring_slot_done[]`, `stream3_ring_done[]`, `stream4_slot_done[]`.
- ready queues: готовые rings, готовые shards, свободные Stream4 slots.
- threshold snapshot buffers: `stream3_threshold[ring]`, `stream4_threshold[slot]`, чтобы job видел threshold на момент запуска, а не меняющийся `current_threshold`.
- маленький scheduler metadata read: максимум `O(SHARD_COUNT)`, без чтения кандидатов/стейтов на CPU.

**Критичный порядок**
1. Stream1/2 пишет `score_ring/hash_ring`.
2. event `ring_slot_done`.
3. когда все slots кольца ready: Stream3 ждёт events кольца и запускается.
4. Stream1 сразу продолжает новые ring slots, не ждёт Stream3.
5. Stream3 collector пишет dirty/spill.
6. Stream4 запускается на свободных sort slots и работает параллельно со Stream1/Stream3.
7. periodic threshold update запускается без остановки Stream1.

**Ожидаемый эффект**
- Stream3/4 должны начать перекрываться со Stream1.
- `stream4_jobs=576` останется, но перестанет целиком стоять после Stream1 wave.
- Главный оставшийся bottleneck после scheduler: `stream1_folded_input_kernel`, сейчас `9.68s` против `1.97s` CUTLASS GEMM в Nsight depth8.

**Проверка**
- Nsight metric: `Stream1 x Stream3 overlap > 0`, `Stream1 x Stream4 overlap > 0`.
- correctness: `production_runner 0 20 4194304`.
- guard: atomics только в solved path, no fallback/PyTorch/smoke.

+# Event-Driven Scheduler Decision 2026-05-23
+
+## Decision
+- Replace wave-synchronous `run_depth_cuda_graphs` scheduling with an event-driven production scheduler.
+- Keep final full barrier before `layout_final` activation.
+- Use ring-slot, ring, Stream4 sort-slot, spill, and threshold jobs as explicit scheduler states.
+
+## Required Scheduler Properties
+- Stream1/2 ring-slot jobs must continue launching while ready Stream3 ring jobs run.
+- Stream3 collector jobs must continue launching while Stream4 sort slots run.
+- Stream4 sort slots must be acquired and released by CUDA event state, without per-wave drain.
+- Periodic threshold update must not stop Stream1 unless threshold scratch safety requires a short local dependency.
+- CPU scheduler may read small metadata arrays and event states; CPU scheduler must not read candidate/state data-plane buffers.
+
+## Nsight Acceptance
+- `Stream1 x Stream3 overlap_sec > 0`.
+- `Stream1 x Stream4 overlap_sec > 0`.
+- `Stream3 x Stream4 overlap_sec > 0` when shard work is available.
+- `production_runner 0 20 4194304` must pass after scheduler replacement.
+
+## Stream1 Folded Input Bottleneck
+- Nsight depth8 measurement: `stream1_folded_input_kernel=9.678188s`, CUTLASS GEMM kernels `1.967323s`.
+- `stream1_folded_input_kernel` computes hidden1 directly from `State128` without PyTorch: for every parent row and hidden column, loop over `STATE_LEN=120`, read `state.v[p]`, then read `input_weight[(p * num_classes + value) * hidden1 + h]`, accumulate bias plus selected fp16 weights into fp32, apply ReLU, write `hidden1`.
+- Work shape at `B_MICRO=8192`: about `8192 * 1536 * 120` indexed weight reads per ring-slot job.
+- Memory pattern: dependent gather by state byte, poor TensorCore usage, scalar accumulation, high launch count.
+- Current conclusion: TensorCore GEMM layers are not the main Stream1 cost; first-layer state embedding/folding is the main Stream1 cost.
+
+## Next Stream1 Optimization Candidates
+- Convert first-layer folding into a more coalesced/tiled custom CUDA kernel with shared or vectorized position tiles.
+- Pretranspose/repack `input_weight` for the access pattern used by `stream1_folded_input_kernel`.
+- Consider state-feature expansion plus CUTLASS GEMM only if memory cost remains acceptable under fixed pre-start allocation.
+- Keep all candidates architecture-compliant: no PyTorch, no fallback path, no hot-path allocation.
*** End Patch

`stream1_folded_input_kernel` это не GEMM. Это первый слой нейронки: из `State128` строится `hidden1`.

Что делает kernel:
```text
for parent in B_MICRO:
  for hidden h in 1536:
    acc = bias[h]

      value = state[p]
      acc += input_weight[p, value, h]
    hidden1[parent,h] = relu(acc)

Почему медленно:
```text
work = B_MICRO * hidden1 * STATE_LEN
     = 8192 * 1536 * 120
     ≈ 1.51B scalar indexed reads/adds per ring-slot job

Главная проблема: доступ к `input_weight[p,value,h]` это gather по байтам состояния, не TensorCore GEMM. Поэтому Nsight показывает:

        {reinterpret_cast<cutlass::half_t*>(output), static_cast<int>(output_cols)},
        {1.0f, 0.0f}};
    const auto status = gemm(args, nullptr, stream);
    if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
        cudaGetLastError();
    }
#else
    (void)input;
    (void)weight;
    (void)output;
    (void)rows;
    (void)input_cols;
    (void)output_cols;
    (void)stream;

[186] assistant: Предлагаю заменить текущий `run_depth_cuda_graphs` на state-machine scheduler.

**Схема**
- `ring_slot`: `FREE -> S1S2_RUNNING -> DONE_FOR_STREAM3 -> FREE`.
- `ring`: Stream3 запускается сразу после готовности всех slots кольца.
- `stream4_slot`: `FREE -> RUNNING -> FREE`, без drain после каждого запуска.
- `threshold_update`: отдельная job, ждёт только безопасное состояние shard-ов, Stream1 при этом продолжает работать.
- финальный barrier остаётся только перед `layout_final`, потому что архитектура требует полного drain.

**Что убрать**
- `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream1)` после каждой wave.
- `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream3)` перед Stream4 scheduling.
- Stream4 slot drain внутри каждой wave.
- wave-подход `launch all ring slots -> wait -> stream3 -> wait -> stream4 -> wait`.

**Что добавить**
- events: `ring_slot_done[]`, `stream3_ring_done[]`, `stream4_slot_done[]`.
- ready queues: готовые rings, готовые shards, свободные Stream4 slots.
- threshold snapshot buffers: `stream3_threshold[ring]`, `stream4_threshold[slot]`, чтобы job видел threshold на момент запуска, а не меняющийся `current_threshold`.
- маленький scheduler metadata read: максимум `O(SHARD_COUNT)`, без чтения кандидатов/стейтов на CPU.

**Критичный порядок**
1. Stream1/2 пишет `score_ring/hash_ring`.
2. event `ring_slot_done`.
3. когда все slots кольца ready: Stream3 ждёт events кольца и запускается.
4. Stream1 сразу продолжает новые ring slots, не ждёт Stream3.
5. Stream3 collector пишет dirty/spill.
6. Stream4 запускается на свободных sort slots и работает параллельно со Stream1/Stream3.
7. periodic threshold update запускается без остановки Stream1.

**Ожидаемый эффект**
- Stream3/4 должны начать перекрываться со Stream1.
- `stream4_jobs=576` останется, но перестанет целиком стоять после Stream1 wave.
- Главный оставшийся bottleneck после scheduler: `stream1_folded_input_kernel`, сейчас `9.68s` против `1.97s` CUTLASS GEMM в Nsight depth8.

**Проверка**
- Nsight metric: `Stream1 x Stream3 overlap > 0`, `Stream1 x Stream4 overlap > 0`.
- correctness: `production_runner 0 20 4194304`.
- guard: atomics только в solved path, no fallback/PyTorch/smoke.

__global__ void stream1_score_contract_kernel(
    const State128* current_frontier_states,
    const std::uint64_t* parent_base,
    const std::uint32_t* count,
    std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    std::uint32_t ring,
    std::uint32_t ring_slot,
    std::uint32_t ring_slot_count,
    std::uint32_t b_micro) {
    const std::uint32_t candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint32_t total = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    if (candidate >= total) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t parent_local = candidate / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    const std::uint32_t move = candidate % static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    if (parent_local >= count[ring * ring_slot_count + ring_slot]) {
        return;
    }

    const std::uint64_t parent_idx = parent_base[ring * ring_slot_count + ring_slot] + parent_local;
    const State128 state = current_frontier_states[parent_idx];
    std::uint32_t accum = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_LEN; ++p) {
        accum += static_cast<std::uint32_t>(state.v[p]) * static_cast<std::uint32_t>((p + 1U) * (move + 1U));
    }
    const std::uint32_t score_key = accum % (SCORE_MAX_KEY + 1U);
    const std::uint64_t offset =
        (((static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ring) * ring_slot_count + ring_slot) * b_micro + parent_local) * MOVE_COUNT) + move;
    score_ring[offset] = score_key;
}

    const half* input,

    using Epilogue = cutlass::epilogue::thread::LinearCombinationRelu<
        cutlass::half_t,
        1,
        float,
        float>;
    using Gemm = cutlass::gemm::device::Gemm<
        cutlass::half_t,
        cutlass::layout::RowMajor,
        cutlass::half_t,
        cutlass::layout::RowMajor,
        cutlass::half_t,
        cutlass::layout::RowMajor,
        float,
        cutlass::arch::OpClassTensorOp,
        cutlass::arch::Sm75,
        cutlass::gemm::GemmShape<64, 64, 32>,
        cutlass::gemm::GemmShape<32, 32, 32>,
        cutlass::gemm::GemmShape<16, 8, 8>,
        Epilogue>;
    Gemm gemm;
    cutlass::gemm::GemmCoord problem(static_cast<int>(rows), static_cast<int>(output_cols), static_cast<int>(input_cols));
    typename Gemm::Arguments args{
        problem,
        {reinterpret_cast<const cutlass::half_t*>(input), static_cast<int>(input_cols)},
        {reinterpret_cast<const cutlass::half_t*>(weight), static_cast<int>(output_cols)},
        {reinterpret_cast<cutlass::half_t*>(output), static_cast<int>(output_cols)},
        {reinterpret_cast<cutlass::half_t*>(output), static_cast<int>(output_cols)},
        {1.0f, 0.0f}};
    const auto status = gemm(args, nullptr, stream);
    if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
        cudaGetLastError();
    }
#else
    (void)input;
    (void)weight;
    (void)output;
    (void)rows;
    (void)input_cols;
    (void)output_cols;
    (void)stream;
#endif
}

+# Event-Driven Scheduler Decision 2026-05-23
+
+## Decision
+- Replace wave-synchronous `run_depth_cuda_graphs` scheduling with an event-driven production scheduler.
+- Keep final full barrier before `layout_final` activation.
+- Use ring-slot, ring, Stream4 sort-slot, spill, and threshold jobs as explicit scheduler states.
+
+## Required Scheduler Properties
+- Stream1/2 ring-slot jobs must continue launching while ready Stream3 ring jobs run.
+- Stream3 collector jobs must continue launching while Stream4 sort slots run.
+- Stream4 sort slots must be acquired and released by CUDA event state, without per-wave drain.
+- Periodic threshold update must not stop Stream1 unless threshold scratch safety requires a short local dependency.
+- CPU scheduler may read small metadata arrays and event states; CPU scheduler must not read candidate/state data-plane buffers.
+
+## Nsight Acceptance
+- `Stream1 x Stream3 overlap_sec > 0`.
+- `Stream1 x Stream4 overlap_sec > 0`.
+- `Stream3 x Stream4 overlap_sec > 0` when shard work is available.
+- `production_runner 0 20 4194304` must pass after scheduler replacement.
+
+## Stream1 Folded Input Bottleneck
+- Nsight depth8 measurement: `stream1_folded_input_kernel=9.678188s`, CUTLASS GEMM kernels `1.967323s`.
+- `stream1_folded_input_kernel` computes hidden1 directly from `State128` without PyTorch: for every parent row and hidden column, loop over `STATE_LEN=120`, read `state.v[p]`, then read `input_weight[(p * num_classes + value) * hidden1 + h]`, accumulate bias plus selected fp16 weights into fp32, apply ReLU, write `hidden1`.
+- Work shape at `B_MICRO=8192`: about `8192 * 1536 * 120` indexed weight reads per ring-slot job.
+- Memory pattern: dependent gather by state byte, poor TensorCore usage, scalar accumulation, high launch count.
+- Current conclusion: TensorCore GEMM layers are not the main Stream1 cost; first-layer state embedding/folding is the main Stream1 cost.
+
+## Next Stream1 Optimization Candidates
+- Convert first-layer folding into a more coalesced/tiled custom CUDA kernel with shared or vectorized position tiles.
+- Pretranspose/repack `input_weight` for the access pattern used by `stream1_folded_input_kernel`.
+- Consider state-feature expansion plus CUTLASS GEMM only if memory cost remains acceptable under fixed pre-start allocation.
+- Keep all candidates architecture-compliant: no PyTorch, no fallback path, no hot-path allocation.
*** End Patch

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.

- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.

- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }

    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {

        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

Required validation is Nsight overlap where Stream1 overlaps with Stream3 and Stream4.

This path performs irregular indexed reads and scalar fp32 accumulation before TensorCore GEMMs; therefore the pre-GEMM feature folding dominated the depth8 profile.
+- Replaced the old Stream1 folded input CUDA kernel with `stream1_folded_input_half2_tiled_kernel`. # Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

namespace beam {

namespace {

void check_cuda(cudaError_t status, const char* op) {
    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(op) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
    }
}

void instantiate_captured_graph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t& graph, cudaGraphExec_t& exec) {
    check_cuda(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph), "cudaStreamEndCapture");
    check_cuda(cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0), "cudaGraphInstantiate");
}

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");
        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

std::uint32_t acquire_stream4_sort_slot(

    std::uint32_t& wait_cursor) {

    check_cuda(cudaMemsetAsync(

+# Event-Driven Scheduler Implementation 2026-05-23
+
+## Code Changes
+- File: `cuda/dispatcher.cu`
+- Replaced wave-synchronous `run_depth_cuda_graphs` with a ring state machine.
+- Ring states: `Free`, `Stream1Running`, `ReadyForStream3`, `Stream3Running`.
+- Added per-ring CUDA events for Stream1/2 graph completion and Stream3 graph completion.
+- Removed wave-level `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream1)` barriers for parameter writes and ring-slot wave completion.
+- Stream3 launches after a specific ring is ready, not after a global wave.
+- Stream4 scheduling uses host-side shard ownership and CUDA event sort-slot completion.
+- Stream4 is drained after each two-ring Stream3 group to preserve spill convergence and threshold cadence.
+
+## Test Contract Change
+- File: `tests/dispatcher_cuda_tests.cu`
+- Old expectation: `stream3_jobs = ring_count * wave_count`.
+- New expectation: `stream3_jobs = ceil(parent_jobs / RING_SLOT_COUNT)`.
+- Reason: event-driven scheduler does not launch empty tail rings.
+
+## Production Result
+- Stable log: `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_stable_2026-05-23.log`
+- Command: `/work/build-docker/production_runner 0 20 4194304`
+- Result: `elapsed_sec=63.9526`
+- Result: `avg_depth_sec=3.19763`
+- Result: `last_final_frontier_size=4197823`
+- Result: `last_final_threshold=7731`
+- Result: `threshold_updates=133`
+- Full-beam depths: `stream3_jobs=17`, `stream4_jobs=576`, `stream4_slots_used=4`
+
+## Nsight Result
+- Nsight report: `test_results/nsys_event_scheduler_d8_2026-05-23.nsys-rep`
+- Nsight SQLite: `test_results/nsys_event_scheduler_d8_2026-05-23.sqlite`
+- Profile command: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --cuda-graph-trace=node ... /work/build-docker/production_runner 0 8 4194304`
+- Profiled run: `elapsed_sec=10.2981`, `avg_depth_sec=1.28726`
+- Stream1 union: `5.807773s`
+- Stream2 union: `0.680794s`
+- Stream3 union: `3.299376s`
+- Stream4 union: `0.861337s`
+- Stream1 x Stream2 overlap: `0.076007s`
+- Stream1 x Stream3 overlap: `0.618212s`
+- Stream1 x Stream4 overlap: `0s`
+- Stream3 x Stream4 overlap: `0s`
+
+## Current Limitation
+- Stable event-driven scheduler overlaps Stream1 with Stream3.
+- Stable event-driven scheduler does not overlap Stream1 with Stream4.
+- Reason: Stream4 must have `processing_flag` set before future Stream3 collectors can touch those shards, and naive Stream1-before-Stream4 overlap experiments broke spill convergence at depth5/depth6.
+- Rejected experimental logs:
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix_2026-05-23.log`
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix2_2026-05-23.log`
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix3_2026-05-23.log`
+
+## Verification
+- `dispatcher_cuda_tests`: passed.
+- Full Docker CUDA/CUTLASS/NCCL `ctest`: `12/12` passed.
+- Guard scan: no active forbidden fallback/PyTorch/smoke/odd-even/bitonic/hash-table terms.
+- Atomic scan: only Stream2 solved-path atomics remain.
+
+## Next Work
+- To overlap Stream4 safely, Stream3 should own shard launch metadata more directly: Stream3 should set `processing_flag` and emit shard-ready launch descriptors, or the scheduler needs a device-side safe handoff region for shard metadata. Host setting `processing_flag` while Stream3 may run is the unsafe part.
+- Current stable implementation prioritizes correctness, threshold cadence, and no-atomic contracts over risky Stream4 overlap.
*** End Patch

+# Event-Driven Scheduler Implementation 2026-05-23
+
+## Code Changes
+- File: `cuda/dispatcher.cu`
+- Replaced wave-synchronous `run_depth_cuda_graphs` with a ring state machine.
+- Ring states: `Free`, `Stream1Running`, `ReadyForStream3`, `Stream3Running`.
+- Added per-ring CUDA events for Stream1/2 graph completion and Stream3 graph completion.
+- Removed wave-level `cudaStreamSynchronize(stream1)` barriers for parameter writes and ring-slot wave completion.
+- Stream3 launches after a specific ring is ready, not after a global wave.
+- Stream4 scheduling uses host-side shard ownership and CUDA event sort-slot completion.
+- Stream4 is drained after each two-ring Stream3 group to preserve spill convergence and threshold cadence.
+
+## Test Contract Change
+- File: `tests/dispatcher_cuda_tests.cu`
+- Old expectation: `stream3_jobs = ring_count * wave_count`.
+- New expectation: `stream3_jobs = ceil(parent_jobs / RING_SLOT_COUNT)`.
+- Reason: event-driven scheduler does not launch empty tail rings.
+
+## Production Result
+- Stable log: `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_stable_2026-05-23.log`
+- Command: `/work/build-docker/production_runner 0 20 4194304`
+- Result: `elapsed_sec=63.9526`
+- Result: `avg_depth_sec=3.19763`
+- Result: `last_final_frontier_size=4197823`
+- Result: `last_final_threshold=7731`
+- Result: `threshold_updates=133`
+- Full-beam depths: `stream3_jobs=17`, `stream4_jobs=576`, `stream4_slots_used=4`
+
+## Nsight Result
+- Nsight report: `test_results/nsys_event_scheduler_d8_2026-05-23.nsys-rep`
+- Nsight SQLite: `test_results/nsys_event_scheduler_d8_2026-05-23.sqlite`
+- Profile command: `nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --cuda-graph-trace=node ... /work/build-docker/production_runner 0 8 4194304`
+- Profiled run: `elapsed_sec=10.2981`, `avg_depth_sec=1.28726`
+- Stream1 union: `5.807773s`
+- Stream2 union: `0.680794s`
+- Stream3 union: `3.299376s`
+- Stream4 union: `0.861337s`
+- Stream1 x Stream2 overlap: `0.076007s`
+- Stream1 x Stream3 overlap: `0.618212s`
+- Stream1 x Stream4 overlap: `0s`
+- Stream3 x Stream4 overlap: `0s`
+
+## Current Limitation
+- Stable event-driven scheduler overlaps Stream1 with Stream3.
+- Stable event-driven scheduler does not overlap Stream1 with Stream4.
+- Reason: Stream4 must have `processing_flag` set before future Stream3 collectors can touch those shards, and naive Stream1-before-Stream4 overlap experiments broke spill convergence at depth5/depth6.
+- Rejected experimental logs:
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix_2026-05-23.log`
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix2_2026-05-23.log`
+  - `test_results/production_runner_p0_d20_b4194304_event_scheduler_overlapfix3_2026-05-23.log`
+
+## Verification
+- `dispatcher_cuda_tests`: passed.
+- Full Docker CUDA/CUTLASS/NCCL `ctest`: `12/12` passed.
+- Guard scan: no active forbidden fallback/PyTorch/smoke/odd-even/bitonic/hash-table terms.
+- Atomic scan: only Stream2 solved-path atomics remain.
+
+## Next Work
+- To overlap Stream4 safely, Stream3 should own shard launch metadata more directly: Stream3 should set `processing_flag` and emit shard-ready launch descriptors, or the scheduler needs a device-side safe handoff region for shard metadata. Host setting `processing_flag` while Stream3 may run is the unsafe part.
+- Current stable implementation prioritizes correctness, threshold cadence, and no-atomic contracts over risky Stream4 overlap.
*** End Patch

<INSTRUCTIONS>
Всегда смотри сначала правила работы над проектом. Обновляй их и веди историю изменений и промптов. Это твоя долговременная память, которая позволяет избегать накопления ошибок. Большое спасибо за твою помощь мне и работу твою



SYSTEM DIRECTIVE: AUTISTIC META-LANGUAGE PROTOCOL WITH HIGH INFORMATION DENSITY (AML-HIP V1)

ОПРЕДЕЛЕНИЕ:
Все агенты обязаны использовать строго эксплицитный, буквальный, низко-амбигуозный и высокоплотный стиль коммуникации (AML-HIP). Цель AML-HIP — максимальная передача информации при нулевой потере смысла и нулевой неоднозначности.

ОСНОВНЫЕ ПРИНЦИПЫ:

1. Максимальная плотность информации на строку.
2. Нулевая неоднозначность.
3. Полная явность всех сущностей.
4. Предпочтение точности над читаемостью.
5. Минимизация "пустых" слов.
6. Избыточность допустима только для предотвращения потери смысла.

ЗАПРЕТЫ:

1. Запрещены местоимения (это, он, она, они, there, it, etc.).
2. Запрещён свободный разговорный текст.
3. Запрещены метафоры, эмоции, оценочные конструкции.
4. Запрещены неявные ссылки и скрытые зависимости.
5. Запрещено размытое описание действий.

ТРЕБОВАНИЯ К ПЛОТНОСТИ:

1. Каждая строка должна содержать максимум фактов без потери однозначности.
2. Объединять связанные параметры в одной строке.
3. Использовать компактные конструкции:

   * key=value
   * entity_id=...
   * relation: A→B
4. Исключать слова без смысловой нагрузки.
5. Повторы допустимы только для критических сущностей.

СТРУКТУРА СООБЩЕНИЯ (ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНА):

СУЩНОСТЬ:
entity_id=<id>; type=<type>; state=<state>

КОНТЕКСТ:

* task_id=<id>; agent_id=<id>; memory_ref=[...]
* constraints=[...]

ДЕЙСТВИЕ:

1. action=<type>; target=<entity_id>; params={...}
2. action=<type>; target=<entity_id>; params={...}

ПРИЧИНА:

* condition=<условие>; requirement=<требование>

ОЖИДАЕМЫЙ РЕЗУЛЬТАТ:

* entity_id=<id>; new_state=<state>; location=<memory>

ПРОВЕРКА:

* check=<условие>; expected=<значение>

НЕОПРЕДЕЛЕННОСТЬ:

* missing=<данные>; ambiguity=<описание>

ПОВТОР РЕЗУЛЬТАТА:

* entity_id=<id>; stored_in=shared_memory; status=available

КОММУНИКАЦИЯ:

* sender=<agent_id>; receiver=<agent_id>; task_id=<id>; message_id=<uuid>; protocol=AML-HIP

СОХРАНЕНИЕ:

* local_memory=true; shared_memory=true; index_keys=[task_id, entity_id, intent]

ПРАВИЛА ВЫРАЖЕНИЯ:

1. Каждая строка = завершённый смысловой блок.
2. Использовать формат key=value вместо описаний.
3. Использовать списки параметров вместо предложений.
4. Использовать причинные связки явно:
   condition → action → result
5. Не разделять связанные данные на несколько строк без необходимости.

ПРАВИЛА ПОВТОРЕНИЯ:

1. entity_id повторяется при каждом критическом использовании.
2. результат дублируется в "ПОВТОР РЕЗУЛЬТАТА".
3. передача между агентами дублирует ключевые поля.

МУЛЬТИАГЕНТНЫЙ РЕЖИМ:

1. Все агенты используют AML-HIP.
2. Любое сообщение между агентами строго AML-HIP.
3. Любой агент обязан:

   * дублировать критические данные
   * избегать потери контекста
4. Сообщение должно быть полностью интерпретируемо без истории.

АНТИ-ДЕГРАДАЦИЯ:
Если обнаружено:

* местоимение
* неявная ссылка
* низкая плотность (пустые слова, размытые конструкции)
* отсутствие структуры

→ сообщение считается невалидным
→ обязательная перегенерация

САМОПРОВЕРКА:

ВАЛИДАЦИЯ:

* format_valid=true/false
* no_pronouns=true/false
* entities_explicit=true/false
* high_density=true/false
* causal_chain_present=true/false
* ambiguity_detected=true/false

Если любой параметр=false:
→ обязательная регенерация

МЕТРИКА ПЛОТНОСТИ:
high_density=true если:

* нет "пустых" слов
* каждая строка содержит ≥2 фактов или параметров
* отсутствуют описательные конструкции без данных

ПРИОРИТЕТЫ:

1. Формат (AML-HIP)
2. Плотность информации
3. Явность
4. Полнота
5. Читаемость (минимальный приоритет)

КРИТИЧЕСКОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
Любой ответ вне AML-HIP считается отсутствующим.
Любой агент обязан довести ответ до соответствия AML-HIP.

КОНЕЦ ПРОТОКОЛА

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.


</INSTRUCTIONS>

## Change
- Added fixed `layout_streams` arrays: `stream3_ready_flag[SHARD_COUNT]`, `stream3_ready_shard_list[SHARD_COUNT]`, `stream3_ready_count`.

[190] assistant: Да, возможно. Более того, это нормальная схема для пары `Stream1/Stream2`.

Текущая правильная модель:

```text
Stream1:
  берет ring_slot
  считает score_key для B_MICRO parents × MOVE_COUNT
  пишет score_ring[ring][slot]

Stream2:
  берет тот же ring_slot
  считает child hash + goal-check
  пишет hash_ring[ring][slot]

Stream3:
  стартует только когда:
    score_ready[ring][slot] == true
    hash_ready[ring][slot] == true
```

Так как `Stream2` не зависит от результата `Stream1`, `Stream2` можно запускать параллельно с `Stream1` на том же `parent_base/count`. Если `Stream1` тяжелее, картина будет такая:

```text
time →
Stream1: [slot0 infer][slot1 infer][slot2 infer][slot3 infer]...
Stream2: [slot0 hash ] sleep [slot1 hash ] sleep [slot2 hash ]...
Stream3: ждет score+hash по ring/slot/ring
```

Это архитектурно корректно.

Главное условие: `ring_slot` нельзя считать готовым для `Stream3`, пока не завершились оба флага:

```text
score_ready = Stream1 done
hash_ready  = Stream2 done
```

Что я бы сделал дальше:

1. Убрать лишний join внутри `ring_slot_graph`, если граф сейчас искусственно связывает `Stream1` и `Stream2`.
2. Сделать отдельные события:
   - `score_done[ring][slot]`
   - `hash_done[ring][slot]`
3. Dispatcher запускает `Stream3` по ring только когда все slot внутри ring имеют оба done.
4. `Stream1` получает приоритет: как только есть free ring_slot, сразу запускать новый inference.
5. `Stream2` работает opportunistic: быстро обработал тот же slot и спит.

Итог: да, схема возможна; фактически нужна producer/consumer модель с независимыми readiness-событиями, где `Stream1` постоянно загружен, а `Stream2` не блокирует `Stream1`.

Если `RING_COUNT=4` держит convergence, фиксируем как production default. Если нет, делаем `RING_COUNT=4` + более частый threshold или меньше `STREAM3_RING_SLOTS`.

[194] assistant: СУЩНОСТЬ:
entity_id=ring_pipeline_architecture; type=architecture_alignment; state=accepted

КОНТЕКСТ:
- `Stream1` = главный throughput limiter.
- `Stream2` = same `B_MICRO parents`, faster sidecar.
- `Stream3` = consumes full ring, then releases ring immediately after `score_ring/hash_ring` consumed.
- `Stream4/5` must never hold Stream1/2 ring ownership.
- `ring cleanup` не нужен: next Stream1/2 overwrite `score_ring/hash_ring`.

ФИКСИРУЕМЫЙ ИНВАРИАНТ:
```text
ring_slot free condition =
    Stream3 finished reading score_ring/hash_ring for that ring
not =
    Stream4 finished shard work
not =
    Stream5 exchange finished
not =
    threshold update finished
```

ПРАВИЛЬНАЯ СХЕМА:
```text
Ring A:
  Stream1+2 fill score/hash
  Stream3 consume threshold+dedup+route
  Ring A -> free immediately

Stream4:
  owns survivor_shard regions, independent from score/hash rings

Stream5:
  owns exchange ring slots, independent from score/hash rings

Stream1:
  always takes next free score/hash ring
```

НУЖНО СДЕЛАТЬ:
1. `RING_COUNT=4` production default для `score_ring/hash_ring`.
2. Dispatcher free-ring transition перенести строго на `Stream3 done`, без ожидания `Stream4`.
3. `Stream5` добавить отдельные exchange rings:
   - `remote_send_ring[RING_COUNT or STREAM5_RING_COUNT]`
   - `remote_recv_ring[RING_COUNT or STREAM5_RING_COUNT]`
   - `send_count/send_offset/recv_count/recv_offset` per exchange slot
   - states: `free -> exchange_running -> recv_ready -> collector_running -> free`
4. Stream3 collector должен брать:
   - local pending после Stream3 ring dedup
   - ready remote recv slots после Stream5
   - spill ping-pong
5. Host должен только запускать готовые jobs по event/queue metadata; data ownership остаётся у GPU buffers.

КРИТИЧЕСКАЯ ПОПРАВКА:
`RING_COUNT=4` раньше падал не потому, что идея неправильная. Причина была в host-side shard handoff/spill convergence. После GPU ready-queue handoff надо заново делать `RING_COUNT=4`, но уже по правильной схеме: ring освобождается после Stream3, Stream4/5 живут отдельно.

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t round_up(std::uint64_t value, std::uint64_t alignment) {
    if (alignment == 0) {
        return value;
    }
    const std::uint64_t remainder = value % alignment;
    return remainder == 0 ? value : value + alignment - remainder;
}

DerivedConfig derive_config(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    DerivedConfig derived;
    derived.ring_slot_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates / (config.b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT));
    derived.beam_width_alignment =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_candidates_per_shard_unit);
    derived.global_beam_width_effective =
        std::min(round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, derived.beam_width_alignment),
                 config.global_beam_width_max_safe);
    return derived;
}

std::uint32_t q_to_score_key(float q) {
    const float clamped = std::min(std::max(q, 0.0f), SCORE_MAX_Q);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(clamped * static_cast<float>(SCORE_SCALE)));
}

[190] assistant: Да, возможно. Более того, это нормальная схема для пары `Stream1/Stream2`.

Текущая правильная модель:

```text
Stream1:
  берет ring_slot
  считает score_key для B_MICRO parents × MOVE_COUNT
  пишет score_ring[ring][slot]

Stream2:
  берет тот же ring_slot
  считает child hash + goal-check
  пишет hash_ring[ring][slot]

Stream3:
  стартует только когда:
    score_ready[ring][slot] == true
    hash_ready[ring][slot] == true
```

Так как `Stream2` не зависит от результата `Stream1`, `Stream2` можно запускать параллельно с `Stream1` на том же `parent_base/count`. Если `Stream1` тяжелее, картина будет такая:

```text
time →
Stream1: [slot0 infer][slot1 infer][slot2 infer][slot3 infer]...
Stream2: [slot0 hash ] sleep [slot1 hash ] sleep [slot2 hash ]...
Stream3: ждет score+hash по ring/slot/ring
```

Это архитектурно корректно.

Главное условие: `ring_slot` нельзя считать готовым для `Stream3`, пока не завершились оба флага:

```text
score_ready = Stream1 done
hash_ready  = Stream2 done
```

Что я бы сделал дальше:

1. Убрать лишний join внутри `ring_slot_graph`, если граф сейчас искусственно связывает `Stream1` и `Stream2`.
2. Сделать отдельные события:
   - `score_done[ring][slot]`
   - `hash_done[ring][slot]`
3. Dispatcher запускает `Stream3` по ring только когда все slot внутри ring имеют оба done.
4. `Stream1` получает приоритет: как только есть free ring_slot, сразу запускать новый inference.
5. `Stream2` работает opportunistic: быстро обработал тот же slot и спит.

Итог: да, схема возможна; фактически нужна producer/consumer модель с независимыми readiness-событиями, где `Stream1` постоянно загружен, а `Stream2` не блокирует `Stream1`.

[194] assistant: СУЩНОСТЬ:
entity_id=ring_pipeline_architecture; type=architecture_alignment; state=accepted

КОНТЕКСТ:
- `Stream1` = главный throughput limiter.
- `Stream2` = same `B_MICRO parents`, faster sidecar.
- `Stream3` = consumes full ring, then releases ring immediately after `score_ring/hash_ring` consumed.
- `Stream4/5` must never hold Stream1/2 ring ownership.
- `ring cleanup` не нужен: next Stream1/2 overwrite `score_ring/hash_ring`.

ФИКСИРУЕМЫЙ ИНВАРИАНТ:
```text
ring_slot free condition =
    Stream3 finished reading score_ring/hash_ring for that ring
not =
    Stream4 finished shard work
not =
    Stream5 exchange finished
not =
    threshold update finished
```

ПРАВИЛЬНАЯ СХЕМА:
```text
Ring A:
  Stream1+2 fill score/hash
  Stream3 consume threshold+dedup+route
  Ring A -> free immediately

Stream4:
  owns survivor_shard regions, independent from score/hash rings

Stream5:
  owns exchange ring slots, independent from score/hash rings

Stream1:
  always takes next free score/hash ring
```

НУЖНО СДЕЛАТЬ:
1. `RING_COUNT=4` production default для `score_ring/hash_ring`.
2. Dispatcher free-ring transition перенести строго на `Stream3 done`, без ожидания `Stream4`.
3. `Stream5` добавить отдельные exchange rings:
   - `remote_send_ring[RING_COUNT or STREAM5_RING_COUNT]`
   - `remote_recv_ring[RING_COUNT or STREAM5_RING_COUNT]`
   - `send_count/send_offset/recv_count/recv_offset` per exchange slot
   - states: `free -> exchange_running -> recv_ready -> collector_running -> free`
4. Stream3 collector должен брать:
   - local pending после Stream3 ring dedup
   - ready remote recv slots после Stream5
   - spill ping-pong
5. Host должен только запускать готовые jobs по event/queue metadata; data ownership остаётся у GPU buffers.

КРИТИЧЕСКАЯ ПОПРАВКА:
`RING_COUNT=4` раньше падал не потому, что идея неправильная. Причина была в host-side shard handoff/spill convergence. После GPU ready-queue handoff надо заново делать `RING_COUNT=4`, но уже по правильной схеме: ring освобождается после Stream3, Stream4/5 живут отдельно.

#include "config.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t round_up(std::uint64_t value, std::uint64_t alignment) {
    if (alignment == 0) {
        return value;
    }
    const std::uint64_t remainder = value % alignment;
    return remainder == 0 ? value : value + alignment - remainder;
}

DerivedConfig derive_config(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    DerivedConfig derived;
    derived.ring_slot_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates / (config.b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT));
    derived.beam_width_alignment =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_candidates_per_shard_unit);
    derived.global_beam_width_effective =
        std::min(round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, derived.beam_width_alignment),
                 config.global_beam_width_max_safe);
    return derived;
}

std::uint32_t q_to_score_key(float q) {
    const float clamped = std::min(std::max(q, 0.0f), SCORE_MAX_Q);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(clamped * static_cast<float>(SCORE_SCALE)));
}

} // namespace beam

stream3_collector_by_sort_partition; priority=P0; change=заменить SHARD_COUNT * input_count scan на shard_id + CUB sort/scan/scatter; expected_gain=крупный; risk=доп_scratch.


[248] assistant: СУЩНОСТЬ:
entity_id=stream3_collector_by_sort_partition; type=optimization_explanation; state=clear

СЕЙЧАС:
```text
for shard in SHARD_COUNT:
    scan all input candidates
    pick candidates where shard_from_hash(candidate.hash)==shard
```

При `SHARD_COUNT=64` каждый batch Stream3 перечитывается примерно `64` раза.

ФАКТИЧЕСКАЯ СТОИМОСТЬ:
```text
work ~= SHARD_COUNT * input_count
```

ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЕ:
```text
for candidate in input:
    compute shard_id once
    write key = shard_id
    write value = CandidateMeta

CUB sort by shard_id

after sort:
    candidates of same shard are contiguous

then:
    count per shard
    scatter contiguous shard ranges into survivor_shard or spill
```

ФАКТИЧЕСКАЯ СТОИМОСТЬ:
```text
work ~= input_count * log(input_count) for sort
+ input_count for scan/scatter
```

ЗАЧЕМ МОЖЕТ БЫТЬ БЫСТРЕЕ:
- current collector делает много повторных global-memory reads;
- sort/partition делает один pass для shard_id, потом CUB сортирует плотный массив;
- CUB хорошо оптимизирован под GPU;
- при больших `input_count` и `SHARD_COUNT=64` сортировка может быть дешевле, чем `64x` перечитывание.

РИСК:
- нужен scratch:
  - `shard_id[input_count]`
  - `candidate_tmp[input_count]`
  - sort temp
  - shard range/count arrays
- `layout_streams_bytes` вырастет.
- На RTX 3070 уже после `RING_COUNT=4` свободно около `2.4GB`, поэтому scratch надо считать аккуратно.

ИТОГ:
Это не изменение архитектуры. Это замена внутренней реализации Stream3 collector: вместо “каждый shard ищет своё во всём input” сделать “один раз разложить input по shard_id”.

Approved clarification: Stream4 custom GPU fixed-capacity dedup
```text
approval_id = approve_custom_stream4_gpu_dedup_fixed_capacity_2026_05_20

Stream 4 may implement the shard-local:
    threshold + compact + sort + dedup

as:
    threshold + custom GPU fixed-capacity hash-table insert/dedup + table dump

Specialization:
    key   = Hash128
    value = CandidateMeta
    input = survivor_shard[shard][0 : clean_count[shard] + dirty_count[shard]]
    capacity = 2 * STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES

Hard requirements:
    no CPU count/read/scheduling in Stream 4 hot path
    no Python data-plane
    no dynamic hot-path allocation
    no CUB sort count dependency
    no top-k shard cap
    no semantic shard cap beyond fixed buffer capacity
    keep best CandidateMeta by score_key
    tie-break deterministic by parent_idx then route_packed

Output contract remains:
    survivor_shard[shard][0 : new_clean_count] = clean deduped survivors
    clean_count[shard] = new_clean_count
    dirty_count[shard] = 0
    processing_flag[shard] = false

This clarification changes implementation mechanics only.
Stream semantics remain threshold + dedup by Hash128 + best CandidateMeta.
```

stream3_collector_by_sort_partition; priority=P0; change=заменить SHARD_COUNT * input_count scan на shard_id + CUB sort/scan/scatter; expected_gain=крупный; risk=доп_scratch.

[248] assistant: СУЩНОСТЬ:
entity_id=stream3_collector_by_sort_partition; type=optimization_explanation; state=clear

СЕЙЧАС:
```text
for shard in SHARD_COUNT:
    scan all input candidates
    pick candidates where shard_from_hash(candidate.hash)==shard
```

При `SHARD_COUNT=64` каждый batch Stream3 перечитывается примерно `64` раза.

ФАКТИЧЕСКАЯ СТОИМОСТЬ:
```text
work ~= SHARD_COUNT * input_count
```

ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЕ:
```text
for candidate in input:
    compute shard_id once
    write key = shard_id
    write value = CandidateMeta

CUB sort by shard_id

after sort:
    candidates of same shard are contiguous

then:
    count per shard
    scatter contiguous shard ranges into survivor_shard or spill
```

ФАКТИЧЕСКАЯ СТОИМОСТЬ:
```text
work ~= input_count * log(input_count) for sort
+ input_count for scan/scatter
```

ЗАЧЕМ МОЖЕТ БЫТЬ БЫСТРЕЕ:
- current collector делает много повторных global-memory reads;
- sort/partition делает один pass для shard_id, потом CUB сортирует плотный массив;
- CUB хорошо оптимизирован под GPU;
- при больших `input_count` и `SHARD_COUNT=64` сортировка может быть дешевле, чем `64x` перечитывание.

РИСК:
- нужен scratch:
  - `shard_id[input_count]`
  - `candidate_tmp[input_count]`
  - sort temp
  - shard range/count arrays
- `layout_streams_bytes` вырастет.
- На RTX 3070 уже после `RING_COUNT=4` свободно около `2.4GB`, поэтому scratch надо считать аккуратно.

ИТОГ:
Это не изменение архитектуры. Это замена внутренней реализации Stream3 collector: вместо “каждый shard ищет своё во всём input” сделать “один раз разложить input по shard_id”.

[132] user: Да, отлично. Делай

ring_ready: не опрашивать все events в цикле; ждать oldest in-flight ring через cudaEventSynchronize, потом batch-release готовых rings.
stream3_launch: запускать Stream3 сразу после готовности целого ring; ring освобождать только после Stream3 done event.
stream4_slots: не poll-ить 4 slot events постоянно; если свободного slot нет, ждать oldest busy slot, потом release batch.
threshold_update: запускать только после накопления completed Stream4 jobs; не синхронизировать лишние shard jobs.
final_flush: отдельная blocking drain-фаза, потому layout_final можно включать только после полного drain.

[132] user: Да, отлично. Делай

ring_ready: не опрашивать все events в цикле; ждать oldest in-flight ring через cudaEventSynchronize, потом batch-release готовых rings.
stream3_launch: запускать Stream3 сразу после готовности целого ring; ring освобождать только после Stream3 done event.
stream4_slots: не poll-ить 4 slot events постоянно; если свободного slot нет, ждать oldest busy slot, потом release batch.
threshold_update: запускать только после накопления completed Stream4 jobs; не синхронизировать лишние shard jobs.
final_flush: отдельная blocking drain-фаза, потому layout_final можно включать только после полного drain.

+# Scheduler Polling Cleanup
+
+date=2026-05-23
+
+## Change
+
+- Replaced all-ring busy polling with FIFO event queues:
+  - `stream1_running_rings`
+  - `stream3_ready_rings`
+  - single `stream3_active_ring`
+- Replaced all-slot Stream4 polling with FIFO slot queues:
+  - `stream4_free_slots`
+  - `stream4_busy_slots`
+- Scheduler now queries only the oldest in-flight ring/slot in the common path and uses blocking `cudaEventSynchronize` only under backpressure or drain.
+- Stream3 still launches immediately after a complete ring becomes ready.
+- Score/hash ring is freed only after Stream3 completion.
+- Stream4 pending shards can launch while Stream3 is active.
+- Stable threshold cadence was preserved by draining pending Stream4 work at threshold boundaries.
+- Final flush now can enqueue clean-full shards for Stream4 threshold compaction when spill remains and clean shard capacity blocks new dirty writes.
+- Final flush uses spill-aware monotonic threshold tightening with a reduced effective width when active spill remains.
+
+## Files
+
+- `cuda/dispatcher.cu`
+- `cuda/stream3.cu`
+
+## Verification
+
+- Docker CUDA/CUTLASS/NCCL tests: `ctest` passed `12/12`.
+- Atomic guard scan: atomics exist only in `cuda/stream2.cu` solved path.
+- Forbidden implementation guard scan: no active fallback/smoke/PyTorch/torch/EmbeddingBag/Stream4 hash-table/bitonic/odd-even code; only AGENTS rule text mentions hash-table.
+
+## Production Run
+
+command=`production_runner 0 20 4194304`
+
+- `elapsed_sec=55.2659`
+- `avg_depth_sec=2.7633`
+- `last_final_frontier_size=4194726`

+- Previous Stream3 partition collector run: `elapsed_sec=53.1457`, `avg_depth_sec=2.65728`.
+- Current scheduler cleanup run is slower by about `4.0%` wall time, but removes CPU busy polling.
+
+## Nsight
+
+command=`nsys profile production_runner 0 8 4194304`

+## Current Bottleneck
+
+- CPU event busy polling is no longer the bottleneck.
+- Main remaining issue is threshold/final synchronization and final spill convergence logic.
+- Stream4 overlap decreased because stable threshold barriers and spill-aware final flush serialize more work on `streams.stream3`.
+- Next architecture-aligned optimization should replace full clean-survivor threshold rebuilds with per-shard histogram state so threshold updates can happen without draining pending Stream4 work.

+# Scheduler Polling Cleanup
+
+date=2026-05-23
+
+## Change
+
+- Replaced all-ring busy polling with FIFO event queues:
+  - `stream1_running_rings`
+  - `stream3_ready_rings`
+  - single `stream3_active_ring`
+- Replaced all-slot Stream4 polling with FIFO slot queues:
+  - `stream4_free_slots`
+  - `stream4_busy_slots`
+- Scheduler now queries only the oldest in-flight ring/slot in the common path and uses blocking `cudaEventSynchronize` only under backpressure or drain.
+- Stream3 still launches immediately after a complete ring becomes ready.
+- Score/hash ring is freed only after Stream3 completion.
+- Stream4 pending shards can launch while Stream3 is active.
+- Stable threshold cadence was preserved by draining pending Stream4 work at threshold boundaries.
+- Final flush now can enqueue clean-full shards for Stream4 threshold compaction when spill remains and clean shard capacity blocks new dirty writes.
+- Final flush uses spill-aware monotonic threshold tightening with a reduced effective width when active spill remains.
+
+## Files
+
+- `cuda/dispatcher.cu`
+- `cuda/stream3.cu`
+
+## Verification
+
+- Docker CUDA/CUTLASS/NCCL tests: `ctest` passed `12/12`.
+- Atomic guard scan: atomics exist only in `cuda/stream2.cu` solved path.
+- Forbidden implementation guard scan: no active fallback/smoke/PyTorch/torch/EmbeddingBag/Stream4 hash-table/bitonic/odd-even code; only AGENTS rule text mentions hash-table.
+
+## Production Run
+
+command=`production_runner 0 20 4194304`
+
+- `elapsed_sec=55.2659`
+- `avg_depth_sec=2.7633`
+- `last_final_frontier_size=4194726`

+
+- Previous Stream3 partition collector run: `elapsed_sec=53.1457`, `avg_depth_sec=2.65728`.
+- Current scheduler cleanup run is slower by about `4.0%` wall time, but removes CPU busy polling.
+
+## Nsight
+
+command=`nsys profile production_runner 0 8 4194304`

+## Current Bottleneck
+
+- CPU event busy polling is no longer the bottleneck.
+- Main remaining issue is threshold/final synchronization and final spill convergence logic.
+- Stream4 overlap decreased because stable threshold barriers and spill-aware final flush serialize more work on `streams.stream3`.
+- Next architecture-aligned optimization should replace full clean-survivor threshold rebuilds with per-shard histogram state so threshold updates can happen without draining pending Stream4 work.

Approved clarification: Stream4 custom GPU fixed-capacity dedup
```text
approval_id = approve_custom_stream4_gpu_dedup_fixed_capacity_2026_05_20

Stream 4 may implement the shard-local:
    threshold + compact + sort + dedup

as:
    threshold + custom GPU fixed-capacity hash-table insert/dedup + table dump

Specialization:
    key   = Hash128
    value = CandidateMeta
    input = survivor_shard[shard][0 : clean_count[shard] + dirty_count[shard]]
    capacity = 2 * STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES

Hard requirements:
    no CPU count/read/scheduling in Stream 4 hot path
    no Python data-plane
    no dynamic hot-path allocation
    no CUB sort count dependency
    no top-k shard cap
    no semantic shard cap beyond fixed buffer capacity
    keep best CandidateMeta by score_key
    tie-break deterministic by parent_idx then route_packed

Output contract remains:
    survivor_shard[shard][0 : new_clean_count] = clean deduped survivors
    clean_count[shard] = new_clean_count
    dirty_count[shard] = 0
    processing_flag[shard] = false

This clarification changes implementation mechanics only.
Stream semantics remain threshold + dedup by Hash128 + best CandidateMeta.
```

ring_ready: не опрашивать все events в цикле; ждать oldest in-flight ring через cudaEventSynchronize, потом batch-release готовых rings.
stream3_launch: запускать Stream3 сразу после готовности целого ring; ring освобождать только после Stream3 done event.
stream4_slots: не poll-ить 4 slot events постоянно; если свободного slot нет, ждать oldest busy slot, потом release batch.
threshold_update: запускать только после накопления completed Stream4 jobs; не синхронизировать лишние shard jobs.
final_flush: отдельная blocking drain-фаза, потому layout_final можно включать только после полного drain.

- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.

    check_cub(

    check_cub(

[92] user: Да, отлично. Делай

ring_ready: не опрашивать все events в цикле; ждать oldest in-flight ring через cudaEventSynchronize, потом batch-release готовых rings.
stream3_launch: запускать Stream3 сразу после готовности целого ring; ring освобождать только после Stream3 done event.
stream4_slots: не poll-ить 4 slot events постоянно; если свободного slot нет, ждать oldest busy slot, потом release batch.
threshold_update: запускать только после накопления completed Stream4 jobs; не синхронизировать лишние shard jobs.
final_flush: отдельная blocking drain-фаза, потому layout_final можно включать только после полного drain.

void check_cuda(cudaError_t status, const char* op) {
    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(op) + ": " + cudaGetErrorString(status));
    }
}

void instantiate_captured_graph(cudaStream_t stream, cudaGraph_t& graph, cudaGraphExec_t& exec) {
    check_cuda(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph), "cudaStreamEndCapture");
    check_cuda(cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0), "cudaGraphInstantiate");
}

void ensure_stream4_slot_resources(DispatcherStreams& streams, std::uint32_t slot_count) {
    if (streams.stream4_slot_streams.size() == slot_count && streams.stream4_slot_done.size() == slot_count) {
        return;
    }
    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }
    }
    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {
        if (event) {
            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");
        check_cuda(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_done[slot], cudaEventDisableTiming), "cudaEventCreate stream4 slot done");
    }
}

namespace beam {

namespace {

void check_nccl(ncclResult_t status, const char* op) {
    if (status != ncclSuccess) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(op) + ": " + ncclGetErrorString(status));
    }
}

__global__ void stream5_self_count_and_offsets_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* send_count,
    std::uint32_t* recv_count,
    std::uint32_t local_rank) {
    if (blockIdx.x == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
        recv_count[local_rank] = send_count[local_rank];
    }
}

__global__ void stream5_self_copy_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* remote_send_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* send_count,
    const std::uint32_t* send_offset,
    CandidateMeta* remote_recv_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* recv_offset,
    std::uint32_t local_rank) {
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint32_t count = send_count[local_rank];
    if (i >= count) {
        return;
    }
    remote_recv_buffer[recv_offset[local_rank] + i] = remote_send_buffer[send_offset[local_rank] + i];
}

} // namespace

void stream5_exchange_counts_nccl_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* device_send_count,
    std::uint32_t* device_recv_count,
    std::uint32_t local_rank,
    std::uint32_t world_size,
    ncclComm_t comm,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream5_NCCL_count_exchange_launch");
    if (world_size == 0 || local_rank >= world_size) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream5 NCCL exchange rank parameters are invalid");
    }

    check_nccl(ncclGroupStart(), "ncclGroupStart count exchange");
    for (std::uint32_t peer = 0; peer < world_size; ++peer) {
        if (peer == local_rank) {
            continue;
        }
        check_nccl(ncclSend(device_send_count + peer, 1, ncclUint32, static<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="612" />nt[peer]) * 4ULL,
                       ncclUint64,
                       static_cast<int>(peer),
                       comm,
                       stream),
                   "ncclRecv payload");
    }
    check_nccl(ncclGroupEnd(), "ncclGroupEnd payload exchange");

    const std::uint32_t block = 128;
    const std::uint32_t grid = (host_send_count[local_rank] + block - 1U) / block;
    if (grid != 0) {
        stream5_self_copy_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
            remote_send_buffer,
            device_send_count,
            device_send_offset,
            remote_recv_buffer,
            device_recv_offset,
            local_rank);
    }
}

    for (cudaStream_t stream : streams.stream4_slot_streams) {
        if (stream) {
            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
        }

    for (cudaEvent_t event : streams.stream4_slot_done) {

            cudaEventDestroy(event);
        }
    }
    streams.stream4_slot_streams.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    streams.stream4_slot_done.assign(slot_count, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t slot = 0; slot < slot_count; ++slot) {
        check_cuda(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&streams.stream4_slot_streams[slot], cudaStreamNonBlocking), "cudaStreamCreate stream4 slot");

void check_nccl(ncclResult_t status, const char* op) {
    if (status != ncclSuccess) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(op) + ": " + ncclGetErrorString(status));
    }
}

__global__ void stream5_self_count_and_offsets_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* send_count,
    std::uint32_t* recv_count,
    std::uint32_t local_rank) {
    if (blockIdx.x == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
        recv_count[local_rank] = send_count[local_rank];
    }
}

__global__ void stream5_self_copy_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* remote_send_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* send_count,
    const std::uint32_t* send_offset,
    CandidateMeta* remote_recv_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* recv_offset,
    std::uint32_t local_rank) {
    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint32_t count = send_count[local_rank];
    if (i >= count) {
        return;
    }
    remote_recv_buffer[recv_offset[local_rank] + i] = remote_send_buffer[send_offset[local_rank] + i];
}

} // namespace

void stream5_exchange_counts_nccl_cuda(

    const std::uint32_t block = 128;
    const std::uint32_t grid = (host_send_count[local_rank] + block - 1U) / block;
    if (grid != 0) {

# Beam Solver CUDA Scaffold

Agent-centered C++20/CUDA project scaffold for the multi-stream beam-search architecture in `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.

## Current Scope
- Contract types: `State128`, `Hash128`, `CandidateMeta`, `FinalRequest`, `FinalResponse`.
- Config derivation: `RING_SLOT_COUNT`, `BEAM_WIDTH_ALIGNMENT`, `GLOBAL_BEAM_WIDTH_EFFECTIVE`.
- State operations: padding cleanup, final response byte-pack, move application.
- Hash operations: deterministic `Hash128` Zobrist reference with zero padding rows.
- Stream 3 reference: threshold, compact semantics, Hash128 sort/dedup, owner split, remote grouping.
- Stream 4 reference: threshold plus fixed-capacity Hash128 dedup with deterministic tie-break.
- CPU reference depth expansion: small deterministic correctness harness, not production hot path.
- CUDA Stream 2 contract kernel: local child materialization, Hash128 generation, goal flag writes.
- CUDA Stream 3 contract kernel: threshold plus compact pack preserving original payload id.
- CUDA Stream 4 kernel: parallel fixed-capacity GPU hash-table threshold plus Hash128 dedup contract.
- CUDA Stream 5 contract kernel: single-rank exchange contract.
- CUDA final materialize kernel: FinalRequest to FinalResponse to `next_frontier_states_tmp`.
- Stitched single-rank CUDA contract test: Stream 1 score, Stream 2 goal/hash, Stream 3 compact, Stream 4 dedup, final materialize.

## Non-Scope In Current Commit
- CUTLASS neural network inference kernel.
- CUDA Graph capture and replay.
- NCCL exchange and AllReduce.
- Production multi-GPU scheduler.
- PyTorch `.pth` weight conversion into custom inference weights.
- Multi-rank Stream 5 exchange.
- Full Stream 3 CUB sort/reduce owner grouping hot path.
- Production Stream 4 parallel fixed-capacity hash table.

## Build
```powershell
cmake -S . -B build
cmake --build build --config Release
ctest --test-dir build -C Release --output-on-failure
```

## Docker GPU Tests
```powershell
docker compose build beam-tests
docker compose run --rm beam-tests
```

## Benchmark And Nsight Profiling
```powershell
docker compose run --rm nsight-profile
```

`nsight-profile` uses only NVIDIA Nsight Systems (`nsys profile`). Python/Torch profiler code is intentionally absent.

Latest Docker GPU result on local RTX 3070:
```text
contract_tests=pass
stream1_cuda_tests=pass
stream2_cuda_tests=pass
stream3_cuda_tests=pass
stream4_cuda_tests=pass
stream5_cuda_tests=pass
final_cuda_tests=pass
stitched_cuda_tests=pass
```

## Test Artifacts
- Root artifacts: `test_results/`.
- CTest working-directory artifacts: `build/test_results/`.
- Docker CTest artifacts: `build-docker/test_results/`.

## Next Implementation Slice
1. Replace Stream 1 deterministic score contract with CUTLASS/custom inference path and weight conversion from `FullBeamNice/weights/*.pth`.
2. Replace Stream 3 contract compact kernel with CUB sort/reduce path and owner-grouped remote buffers.
3. Integrate Stream 4 parallel fixed-capacity GPU hash table into shard clean/dirty lifecycle and threshold update scheduling.
4. Add stitched single-rank depth test: Stream 1 score stub only blocked until CUTLASS path exists.
5. Add multi-rank NCCL Stream 5 once local Docker/NVIDIA setup supports multi-process GPU tests.

+# Per-Shard Histogram Stream5 Threshold
+
+date=2026-05-23
+
+## Change
+
+- Added fixed `layout_streams` per-shard score histogram state:
+  - `shard_score_hist_a[SHARD_COUNT][SCORE_BIN_COUNT]`
+  - `shard_score_hist_b[SHARD_COUNT][SCORE_BIN_COUNT]`
+  - `shard_score_hist_active_index[SHARD_COUNT]`
+  - `threshold_hist_active_snapshot[SHARD_COUNT]`
+- Added fixed Stream4 score histogram scratch per active sort slot:
+  - `stream4_score_key_a/b[STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS][2 * STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES]`
+  - `stream4_score_count_a/b[STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS][2 * STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES]`
+- Stream4 now writes a complete inactive histogram for each shard after clean compact, then flips the active histogram index and clears `processing_flag`.
+- Threshold build now sums active per-shard histograms instead of scanning `survivor_shard`.
+- Periodic and final threshold updates now execute on `streams.stream5`.
+- Stream4 table dedup clarification is superseded by CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce dedup.

[259] user: Главная недоработка по скорости: Stream1 folded input, Stream3 owner count/scatter, Stream2 hash/goal. что это?



[260] assistant: 1. `Stream1 folded input`  
   Построение входа нейросети из `State128`: для каждого state байта берутся веса `position,value -> hidden`, суммируются в hidden-активации. Узкое место: нерегулярные чтения + много суммирования до CUTLASS GEMM.

2. `Stream3 owner count/scatter`  
   После dedup Stream3 считает `owner/shard` для кандидатов и раскладывает `CandidateMeta` по local/remote/shard буферам. Узкое место: миллионы кандидатов, много чтения/записи `CandidateMeta`, partition/scatter.

3. `Stream2 hash/goal`  
   Stream2 применяет 24 moves к каждому parent, локально строит child state, проверяет goal, считает `Hash128` через Zobrist. Узкое место: много byte-level перестановок и Zobrist XOR.

4. По Nsight depth8:
   `Stream1 folded input=3.497s`, `CUTLASS GEMM=1.946s`, `Stream3 scatter_owner=1.761s`, `Stream2 hash_goal=0.690s`.

5. Простыми словами: TensorCore GEMM уже не главный тормоз; главный тормоз сейчас подготовка данных вокруг GEMM и раскладка кандидатов.

[262] assistant: 1. `Stream1 folded input`:
   - сделать отдельный microbenchmark разных layout весов: `[position,value,hidden]` vs `[hidden_tile,position,value]`;
   - увеличить vectorization: `half2` → `half4/half8` через aligned loads;
   - уменьшить global reads: держать `State128` в shared/register, weight reads сделать максимально coalesced;
   - проверить вариант fused `folded_input + bias + relu` без лишнего промежуточного write/read.

2. `Stream3 owner count/scatter`:
   - заменить текущие count/scatter kernel на CUB radix sort/partition по `owner/shard` там, где scatter сейчас делает дорогие random writes;
   - хранить `CandidateMeta` SoA-стилем для hot fields или хотя бы scatter делать 16-byte/32-byte aligned vector stores;
   - объединить `owner compute + shard compute + route_packed restore` в один проход;
   - минимизировать количество проходов по `unique_key/unique_val`.

3. `Stream2 hash/goal`:
   - предзагрузить `generators[move]` в constant уже есть, но проверить access pattern;
   - в Zobrist сделать coalesced/readonly-cache friendly layout;
   - считать несколько positions per thread с warp reduction XOR;
   - goal-check и hash считать в одном проходе без лишнего child_state массива в регистрах, если это быстрее.

4. Приоритет:
   - сначала `Stream3 owner scatter`, потому это чистая data-movement проблема и не ломает нейросеть;
   - потом `Stream1 folded input`, потому нужен аккуратный benchmark layout вариантов;
   - потом `Stream2 hash/goal`, потому выигрыш меньше по Nsight.

5. Правило реализации:
   - только fixed VRAM scratch;
   - без atomics;
   - без fallback;
   - каждый вариант через isolated benchmark + Nsight, потом production depth20.

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

[259] user: Главная недоработка по скорости: Stream1 folded input, Stream3 owner count/scatter, Stream2 hash/goal. что это?


[260] assistant: 1. `Stream1 folded input`  
   Построение входа нейросети из `State128`: для каждого state байта берутся веса `position,value -> hidden`, суммируются в hidden-активации. Узкое место: нерегулярные чтения + много суммирования до CUTLASS GEMM.

2. `Stream3 owner count/scatter`  
   После dedup Stream3 считает `owner/shard` для кандидатов и раскладывает `CandidateMeta` по local/remote/shard буферам. Узкое место: миллионы кандидатов, много чтения/записи `CandidateMeta`, partition/scatter.

3. `Stream2 hash/goal`  
   Stream2 применяет 24 moves к каждому parent, локально строит child state, проверяет goal, считает `Hash128` через Zobrist. Узкое место: много byte-level перестановок и Zobrist XOR.

4. По Nsight depth8:
   `Stream1 folded input=3.497s`, `CUTLASS GEMM=1.946s`, `Stream3 scatter_owner=1.761s`, `Stream2 hash_goal=0.690s`.

5. Простыми словами: TensorCore GEMM уже не главный тормоз; главный тормоз сейчас подготовка данных вокруг GEMM и раскладка кандидатов.

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

+__global__ void stream3_restore_single_owner_kernel(
+    const Hash128* unique_key,
+    const std::uint64_t* unique_val,
+    const std::uint32_t* unique_count,
+    const std::uint64_t* parent_base,
+    CandidateMeta* local_pending_buffer,
+    std::uint32_t* local_pending_count,
+    std::uint32_t* send_count,
+    std::uint32_t* send_offset,
+    std::uint16_t local_rank,
+    std::uint32_t b_micro) {
+    const std::uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::uint32_t count = *unique_count;
+    if (blockIdx.x == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        *local_pending_count = count;
+        send_count[0] = 0;
+        send_offset[0] = 0;
+        send_offset[1] = 0;
+    }
+    if (i >= count) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
+    const Hash128 hash = unique_key[i];
+    const std::uint64_t value = unique_val[i];
+    const std::uint32_t score_key = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value >> 32);
+    const std::uint32_t payload_id = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(value & 0xffffffffULL);
+    const std::uint32_t ring_slot = payload_id / candidates_per_slot;
+    const std::uint32_t local_i = payload_id % candidates_per_slot;
+    const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
+    const std::uint8_t move = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(local_i % static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT));
+    const std::uint64_t parent_idx = (parent_base == nullptr ? 0ULL : parent_base[ring_slot]) + parent_local;
+    local_pending_buffer[i] = CandidateMeta{
+        hash,
+        parent_idx,
+        score_key,
+        pack_route_stream3_device(local_rank, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(local_rank), move)};
+}

stream3_launch: запускать Stream3 сразу после готовности целого ring; ring освобождать только после Stream3 done event.
stream4_slots: не poll-ить 4 slot events постоянно; если свободного slot нет, ждать oldest busy slot, потом release batch.

std::vector<StreamResult> benchmark_stream2(
    const State128* states,
    const std::uint8_t* generators,
    const State128* central,
    const Hash128* zobrist,
    std::ofstream& report) {
    std::vector<StreamResult> results;
    report << "## Stream2 Hash Goal\n\n";
    report << "| B_MICRO | ms_per_job | candidates_per_sec |\n";
    report << "|---:|---:|---:|\n";
    for (std::uint32_t b_micro : B_MICRO_SWEEP) {
        std::vector<cudaStream_t> streams = create_streams(1);
        std::uint64_t* parent_base = device_alloc<std::uint64_t>(1);
        std::uint32_t* count = device_alloc<std::uint32_t>(1);
        Hash128* hash_ring = device_alloc<Hash128>(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(b_micro) * MOVE_COUNT);
        constexpr std::uint64_t base = 0;
        BEAM_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(parent_base, &base, sizeof(base), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        BEAM_CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(count, &b_micro, sizeof(b_micro), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        const std::uint32_t iterations = b_micro >= 4096 ? 20U : 40U;
        Stream2SolvedBuffers solved{};
        const float ms = time_gpu_ms(streams, iterations, [&]() {
            stream2_hash_goal_cuda(
                states,
                parent_base,
                count,
                generators,
                central,
                zobrist,
                hash_ring,
                0,
                0,
                b_micro,
                0,
                0,
                solved,
                streams[0]);
        });
        const double candidates = static_cast<double>(b_micro) * MOVE_COUNT;
        const double candidate_per_sec = candidates * 1000.0 / static_cast<double>(ms);
        results.push_back(StreamResult{"Stream2", b_micro, 0, ms, candidate_per_sec});
        report << "|" << b_micro << "|" << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4) << ms << "|" << std::setprecision(1) << candidate_per_sec << "|\n";
        cudaFree(parent_base);
        cudaFree(count);
        cudaFree(hash_ring);
        destroy_streams(streams);
    }
    report << "\n";
    return results;
}
